purpose: Materialize point-in-time platform, public-revelation/resolution, linked-asset mapping and data-availability evidence for the exact 260 semantically accepted events before any F1-F9, IAS, SMAA ranking, or W3 selection is read.

population.denominator_rule: Every included semantic event remains in the family denominator. Missing, network-failed, ambiguous, or unsupported evidence never removes a row.

forbidden_concepts: realized linked-asset returns used to select or rank families
performance_firewall.rule: Collectors and gate scorers must fail closed if a forbidden local path is opened. IAS/SMAA code is not invoked in PIT-v2.

network_missingness.threshold_rule: PASS iff lower_bound >= threshold; FAIL iff upper_bound < threshold; otherwise INDETERMINATE.
network_missingness.zero_conflict_rule: For max-zero conflict/ambiguity gates, PASS requires zero confirmed conflicts and zero unresolved records capable of containing a conflict; any confirmed conflict is FAIL; otherwise INDETERMINATE.
network_missingness.network_failure_rule: HTTP 429/5xx, timeout, DNS, parse failure, source removal, or robots/access failure is UNRESOLVED, never evidence of absence.

layer_A_polymarket_platform.role: Prove timestamped public market observability before authoritative public revelation.

gamma.use: event/market identifier resolution only: event id, conditionId, clobTokenIds, order-book metadata and resolutionSource metadata

data_api.truncation_semantics: A capped/truncated response cannot establish the true first trade; it is only an observed witness.

clob.use: primary timestamped platform witness for pre-revelation windows
clob.query_semantics: market=token_id; interval=all when available; fidelity=1 minute; bounded startTs/endTs queries around frozen revelation cutoff are preferred

layer_A_polymarket_platform.event_pass_A: At least one timestamped public CLOB price-history observation at or before safe_cutoff. Public Data API trade history may corroborate but is not mandatory when a price witness exists.
layer_A_polymarket_platform.raw_evidence: Store request URL excluding secrets, UTC fetch time, HTTP status, response SHA-256, endpoint, event_id/token_id, pagination/truncation state and parsed witness timestamps.

layer_B_primary_revelation_resolution.common_rule: public_revelation is the earliest verified authoritative public timestamp. A later source cannot be used if an earlier authoritative source may exist but has not been resolved.

precision.SECOND: exact source timestamp; safe_cutoff = revelation - 1 second
precision.MINUTE: safe_cutoff = start of source minute - 1 second
precision.DATE_CONSERVATIVE: safe_cutoff = start of authoritative source-local calendar date - 1 second; timezone must be explicit

revelation_hierarchy: SEC EDGAR 8-K/6-K earnings exhibit acceptance timestamp
EARNINGS_EPS.resolution_requirements: Issuer identity, reporting period, EPS basis/metric and reported value must be objectively supported by issuer IR and/or SEC primary filing. If primary sources conflict materially, AMBIGUOUS.
EARNINGS_EPS.sec_mapping: Ticker-to-CIK is cross-checked; SEC ticker association alone is not treated as infallible identity proof.

revelation_hierarchy: FDA Drugs@FDA approval/action package or FDA public announcement
issuer primary press release/SEC filing describing the FDA action
FDA_FINAL_PDUFA_DECISION.resolution_requirements: Actual FDA action is required. PDUFA target/deadline alone is never treated as decision or resolution evidence.
FDA_FINAL_PDUFA_DECISION.negative_action_rule: A non-approval/CRL outcome requires auditable primary evidence from FDA when public or from the affected issuer when the FDA document is not public; otherwise UNRESOLVED/AMBIGUOUS.

source_hierarchy: other named U.S. statistical agency only if explicitly frozen by event mapping
MACRO_STATISTICAL_RELEASE.revelation_rule: Use the final official release date/time, including documented rescheduling or revised calendars. Stale originally scheduled dates do not override an official revision.
MACRO_STATISTICAL_RELEASE.resolution_requirements: The event metric, reference period, threshold/comparison and official reported value must be objectively mapped to the corresponding agency release.

layer_C_linked_asset_and_data_availabili.mapping_time_rule: Linked asset identity is determined from event/issuer/sponsor/metric identity and frozen structural rules before any realized linked-asset return is read.
layer_C_linked_asset_and_data_availabili.EARNINGS_EPS: Map to the issuer's primary U.S.-listed common equity when tradeable; cross-check issuer identity via issuer/SEC metadata.
layer_C_linked_asset_and_data_availabili.FDA_FINAL_PDUFA_DECISION: Map to the applicant/sponsor's U.S.-listed common equity or clearly documented listed parent. Private/ambiguous sponsor mappings do not pass F5.
layer_C_linked_asset_and_data_availabili.MACRO_STATISTICAL_RELEASE: Map deterministically to SPY as a broad U.S. equity-risk proxy for feasibility only; no claim that SPY is the most sensitive instrument and no return is read during W2-C.
layer_C_linked_asset_and_data_availabili.asset_data_probe: Availability-only daily OHLCV metadata may use the project's disclosed reproducible Yahoo Finance chart-v8 operational source. The probe stores timestamps/row counts/hash/missingness only and is forbidden from computing or persisting returns.

F1_contractability.pass_definition: Uses conservative lower-bound rates over the full frozen family denominator; median uses verified lower-bound hours among records with resolved revelation and timestamped platform history, while unresolved median-capable rows propagate INDETERMINATE when they could change the threshold conclusion.

F2_pm_pit_observability.event_pass: timestamped CLOB price witness exists at/before safe_cutoff and event/token mapping has no confirmed conflict

F3_sampleability_floor.date_cluster: authoritative public revelation calendar date, never Polymarket endDate
F3_sampleability_floor.claim_limit: This is a floor for W3 protocol drafting, not a statistical-power claim.
F3_sampleability_floor.uncertainty_rule: PIT-eligible count and revelation-date cluster count use lower/upper bounds. PASS only if both conservative lower bounds clear thresholds; FAIL only if an optimistic upper bound cannot clear a threshold; otherwise INDETERMINATE.

F8_mandatory_input_coverage.meaning: All mandatory schema fields have explicit values/states. UNRESOLVED is a value and does not itself make F8 missing, but it can prevent other gates from passing.

pit_event_eligible_rule: An event is PIT-eligible only when F1 event-level pre-revelation/24h conditions, F2 event observability/mapping, F4 objective non-ambiguous resolution, F5 linked-asset mapping, F6 asset-data availability, F7 safe cutoff, and F8 schema completeness all pass. F9 is evaluated at family/pipeline level.
scoring_order: only then allow structural IAS evidence scoring
only after IAS evidence freeze run SMAA/ranking
only after ranking and all F1-F9 decide GO/NO-GO W3
prohibitions: No family deletion because evidence is missing or inconvenient.
No use of Gamma start/end dates, current volume, or current liquidity as PIT proof.
No use of PDUFA target date as actual FDA decision timestamp.
No stale macro release schedule when an official rescheduling exists.
No realized linked-asset return read or persisted in W2-C.
No F1-F9 threshold change after real evidence is collected.
No IAS/SMAA/ranking execution before PIT evidence and F1-F9 are frozen.
No W3 execution before a separate W3 protocol freeze.
freeze_rule: PIT-v2 collectors, this protocol, candidate population identity/counts, source rules, missingness bounds, gate formulas and performance firewall must pass synthetic/adversarial validation and be byte-frozen before any real PIT-v2 network collection.
